title: No Wind Sound
description: This resource pack removes the wind charge sound from the game
body:
**The Wind Charge sound can be very distracting, especially during intense PvP or while completing parkour maps.**


This resource pack completely mutes the Wind Charge explosion sound. This allows you to focus on your movement, aim, and gameplay mechanics and removes the annoying noise


## Features:
- Removes Wind Charge explosion sound.
- Client-side only (works on multiplayer servers).
- You're not getting annoyed
